headline: Dolat Algotech CFO certifies commercial paper proceeds utilization for Q3FY26
hook: Procedural filing on short-term debt use
summary: Dolat Algotech's Chief Financial Officer has submitted a formal certificate confirming the proper utilization of proceeds raised through commercial papers for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. This routine regulatory filing ensures compliance with financial transparency standards mandated for listed entities. Such disclosures are standard corporate governance procedures designed to keep investors informed about short-term debt fund allocation. For an Indian retail investor, this holds minimal direct impact on stock valuation or immediate trading momentum.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on stock price

headline: Dolat Algotech appoints Vijyatta Jaiswal as Independent Director
hook: New board appointment at Dolat Algotech
summary: Dolat Algotech Limited has announced the appointment of Mrs. Vijyatta Jaiswal as an Additional Director designated as Independent Director. The appointment is effective from November 1, 2026, for a five-year term ending October 31, 2031. This appointment is subject to prior approvals from stock exchanges and company members. Retail investors should note this routine corporate governance update for board composition tracking.
whats_next: Shareholder and stock exchange approval for the appointment.
why_it_matters: Routine board change with no immediate financial impact on shares.

headline: Dolat Algotech announces a change in its statutory auditors
summary: Dolat Algotech Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a change in its company auditors. The notification pertains to a routine corporate governance procedure. Such updates are procedural filings required by listed companies. Indian retail investors should note this administrative update as standard compliance disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Dolat Algotech appoints statutory auditors and new independent director
hook: New auditor and board member appointed
summary: Dolat Algotech announced the appointment of M/s. Vijay Mehta & Co. as its statutory auditors for a five-year term starting FY 2026-27. The company also appointed Mrs. Vijyatta Jaiswal as an additional director designated as an independent director effective November 1, 2026. Both appointments are subject to shareholder approval and necessary regulatory clearances. These administrative updates form part of the company's routine corporate governance filings.
whats_next: Shareholder approval for auditor and director appointments
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no immediate financial impact
